title: Lotus Pear Drop Studs
descriptionHtml:
Three petals, and a drop that falls from them. Three marquise cut clear cubic zirconia fan out from the lobe like the petals of a lotus, and below them a pear cut drop hangs point up from a small gold jump ring. About 17mm long, they sit close to the ear and catch the light as they move.

STYLING TIP: Wear them with your hair tucked back so the petals show, from a day at work to dinner.

Details

  • Length: Approximately 17mm
  • Fan: Three marquise cut stones, approximately 8.5mm across
  • Drop: One pear cut stone, approximately 6mm by 4.5mm
  • Stone: Clear cubic zirconia
  • Setting: Fine gold claws
  • Closure: Post
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
